admission.justification: Weighed porting the 688-line guard to TypeScript 7's unstable API against isolating a TypeScript 6 compiler-API alias, binding future imports via oxlint no-restricted-imports and deferring the port until TS 7's programmatic API stabilizes.

alternatives.option: Keep TypeScript 7.0.2 owning typescript, tsc -b, typecheck, and build while isolating the newest release line shipping lib/typescript.js (npm:typescript@^6.0.3) under a 'typescript-compiler-api' alias restricted to the three test files by oxlint no-restricted-imports (Option B).
alternatives.reason: Keeps TypeScript 7 owning all product compilation and avoids porting the 688-line wire fixture guard onto an unstable API while containing legacy compiler-API imports to three test files.

alternatives.option: Port wireFixtureGuard.ts, fixtureOverrides.test.ts, and loadIndependence.test.ts directly onto TypeScript 7's programmatic API under typescript/unstable/*.
alternatives.reason: A 688-line static fixture guard should not be ported onto an API explicitly marked unstable.
alternatives.reconsider_when: TypeScript 7's programmatic compiler API leaves unstable/, at which point the three test files should be ported and the typescript-compiler-api alias and no-restricted-imports override dropped.

consequences: Dashboard builds and type checks run on TypeScript 7.0.2; dashboard/package.json carries a temporary typescript-compiler-api alias (npm:typescript@^6.0.3) restricted by dashboard/.oxlintrc.json to three test files, tracked as open debt in wireFixtureGuard.ts's card and weakness record.
context: TypeScript 7.0.2 removed the JavaScript compiler API from the top-level 'typescript' package entry point and exposes programmatic compiler APIs only under 'typescript/unstable/*'; three dashboard test files (wireFixtureGuard.ts, fixtureOverrides.test.ts, loadIndependence.test.ts) rely on the JS compiler API.

evidence: Planted TS2344 break in dashboard/src/test/contract.test.ts:519 caught by tsc 7.0.2 -b; planted restricted import blocked by oxlint (exit 1); clean-copy npm run typecheck, npm run build, and vitest (99/99) pass
